This small plot of 0.28 hectares is just one of my pieces of land, and since I intercrop here with other crops, I rely on what the soil gives me naturally. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer for every plot — here in Kagera the rains come well and I put manure from my cattle on this plot instead. I use seeds I saved from last season like my mother taught me, and my daughter and I will weed by hand. If the weeds become too much near harvest, I may call my neighbor's son for a few days of help.
